ns2:course.label: Intermediate Scandinavian II
ns2:course.description: Further development of communicative skills-reading, writing, speaking and aural comprehension-through the study of authentic texts. Class conducted entirely in the targe language (usually Swedish), with an emphasis on learning about contemporary Sweden, including its role in the European Union. Prerequisite: SCAN 103 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: SCAN 103 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
